source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Once per battle for each unit: in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), as this unit is picked to shoot, you can trigger this, giving this model's own ranged attacks +1 to [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) for the rest of that phase. Track it with the Boss' Ammo Runt token placed beside the unit, taken away once the ability is spent.

effects.durationBasis: core rule 01.02.02 Persisting Rules Effects: no stated duration, so it lasts for the phase it was applied in
